# MT5 fixtures (ground truth for QA)

Raw MT5 data as an `Mt5Source` returns it, loaded by `app.mt5.fixture.FixtureMt5Source`
(format documented in that module). All files are generated by `build_fixtures.py`:

    cd backend && uv run python -m tests.fixtures.mt5.build_fixtures

`tests/mt5/test_fixtures.py` checks the files match the generator and asserts the expected
results below. Edit the generator, not the JSON.

Conventions:
- Times in the files are **server wall clock** epochs (`time`, `time_msc`), FundedNext
  "New York close" time: **UTC+3 until Sun 2026-11-01, UTC+2 after** (`broker_time: ny_close`).
  Each deal/order has a `_server_time` comment. Brussels is UTC+2 until Sun 2026-10-25,
  UTC+1 after. So: week of 19 Oct server = Brussels + 1 h; week of 26 Oct server = Brussels + 2 h;
  from 2 Nov server = Brussels + 1 h again.
- Codes: deal `type` 0 buy, 1 sell, 2 balance; `entry` 0 in, 1 out; `reason` 0 client, 4 sl, 5 tp.
  Order `state` 4 filled. `sl`/`tp` "0" = not set.
- Position id = opening order ticket (as in MT5). Profit/commission/swap are in USD (account).
- Sessions per `config/rules.yaml`: london 08–11, premarket 11–13 (no entries), ny 13–16, Brussels.
- Connect with any non-empty password (the fixture checks it is present, like the real
  source), login/server as below. Wrong login → `login_failed`; no password → `password_missing`.

## Symbol specs (FundedNext-like)

| symbol | digits | contract | tick size | tick value (USD) | volume min/step/max | profit / margin ccy |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| EURUSD | 5 | 100000 | 0.00001 | 1 | 0.01 / 0.01 / 50 | USD / EUR |
| GBPUSD | 5 | 100000 | 0.00001 | 1 | 0.01 / 0.01 / 50 | USD / GBP |
| XAUUSD | 2 | 100 | 0.01 | 1 | 0.01 / 0.01 / 20 | USD / XAU |
| GER40 | 2 | 1 | 0.01 | 0.0116 (0.01 EUR at EURUSD 1.16) | 0.1 / 0.1 / 100 | EUR / EUR |

GER40 profit in USD = points × lots × 1 × 1.16.

## basic_week.json

Account `51234567` @ `FundedNext-Server`, USD. Deposit 100 000.00 on Fri 2026-10-16 12:00 server.
Step 0 = Fri 2026-10-23 13:00 server (10:00 UTC, 12:00 Brussels): balance **101 060.40**,
equity 101 100.40, one open position. Tick time → detected offset **+3**, agrees with ny_close
(verified, no mismatch).

| # | pos id | symbol, dir | open UTC → close UTC | Brussels open, session | entry → exit (VWAP) | vol | gross | comm | net | initial SL (source) | TP | risk | R | planned RR | status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| T1 | 2000101 | EURUSD buy | 10-19 07:30 → 09:30 | Mon 09:30 london | 1.16500 → 1.1679 | 1.00 | 290.00 | −6.00 | 284.00 | 1.16200 (deal) | 1.17000 | 300.00 | 0.9467 | 1.6667 | needs_description |
| T2 | 2000201 | GBPUSD sell | 10-19 12:05 → 13:10 | Mon 14:05 ny | 1.3405 → 1.33700 | 1.00 | 350.00 | −6.00 | 344.00 | 1.34400 (order) | 1.33700 | 350.00 | 0.9829 | 1.0000 | needs_description |
| T3 | 2000301 | XAUUSD buy | 10-20 07:10 → 07:40 | Tue 09:10 london | 4105.50 → 4095.50 | 0.50 | −500.00 | −3.00 | −503.00 | 4095.50 (deal) | 4125.50 | 500.00 | −1.0060 | 2.0000 | needs_description |
| T4 | 2000401 | XAUUSD buy | 10-20 08:05 → 08:50 | Tue 10:05 london | 4093.00 → 4103.00 | 0.50 | 500.00 | −3.00 | 497.00 | 4086.00 (deal) | 4110.00 | 350.00 | 1.4200 | 2.4286 | needs_description |
| T5 | 2000501 | GER40 sell | 10-21 09:30 → 10:40 | Wed 11:30 **premarket** | 24150.00 → 24110.00 | 2.0 | 92.80 | 0.00 | 92.80 | none | none | – | – | – | **needs_sl** |
| T6 | 2000601 | GER40 buy | 10-22 12:00 → 13:20 | Thu 14:00 ny | 24200.00 → 24260.00 | 5.0 | 348.00 | 0.00 | 348.00 | 24170.00 (order) | 24290.00 | 174.00 | 2.0000 | 3.0000 | needs_description |
| T7 | 2000701 | EURUSD sell | 10-23 07:45 → open | Fri 09:45 london | 1.16300 → – | 0.80 | 0.00 | −2.40 | −2.40 | 1.16500 (position) | 1.15900 | 160.00 | – | 2.0000 | **open** |

Scenario notes:
- **T1 partial close**: 3 exit deals 0.40 @1.16700 (+80, comm −1.20), 0.30 @1.16800 (+90, −0.90),
  0.30 @1.16900 (+120, −0.90, Brussels 11:30). One trade, exit VWAP 1.1679, duration 7200 s.
- **T2 scale-in**: second entry 0.50 @1.34100 at 14:20 Brussels into the same position; entry VWAP
  1.3405; SL/TP only on the opening order (deals have 0); closed by TP (reason `tp`).
  Planned RR 1.0 < 1.5 → `min_planned_rr` violation.
- **T3 → T4 loss then re-entry**: T3 stopped out (reason `sl`), T4 same symbol/direction/day/session
  after the loss → **re-entry = true** (first re-entry, so not a max_reentries violation).
- **T5 no SL anywhere** (deal, order, position all 0) → `needs_sl`; entry in **premarket** →
  `entry_session` violation. Risk/R/planned RR null until the user enters an SL.
- **T6** risk via realised conversion 348 × 30/60 = 174.00; the spec fallback gives the same
  (30 / 0.01 × 0.0116 × 5 = 174.00).
- **T7 open position**: SL only on the open position (`positions_get` sl 1.16500, tp 1.15900),
  floating profit 40.00. The worker must remember it as `first_seen_sl` → source `position`.
  Open-trade risk uses the spec fallback: 0.002 / 0.00001 × 1 × 0.8 = 160.00.
- Balance at open (current balance − all deals at/after the open): T1 100 000.00,
  T3 **100 628.00** (risk 0.4969 %), T6 **100 714.80** (risk 0.1728 %).
- Weekly: 7 trades (no max-trades violation), no daily stop hit.

**Step 1** (`advance()`), Fri 16:31 server: T7 closed by deal 1000702, 0.80 @1.16000 at
13:30 UTC (15:30 Brussels, reason client), profit 240.00, comm −2.40 → T7 gross 240.00,
comm −4.80, net **235.20**, risk 160.00, **R 1.4700**, status needs_description.
No open positions; balance = equity = **101 298.00**.
If the worker never saw the open position (no first_seen_sl), T7 has no initial SL → needs_sl.

## dst_switch.json

Account `51234568` @ `FundedNext-Server`, deposit 50 000 (Thu 2026-10-22), final balance
**49 244.60**, no open positions. "Now" tick = Mon 2026-11-02 12:00 server = 10:00 UTC →
detected offset **+2** (agrees with ny_close in winter).

| id | server time (wall) | UTC | Brussels | session | notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| D1 4000101 buy 0.5 EURUSD | Fri 10-23 10:30 → 11:30 | 07:30 → 08:30 | 09:30 CEST | london | +50, comm −3, net 47.00 |
| D2 4000201 sell 0.5 | Mon 10-26 14:30 → 15:00 | 11:30 → 12:00 | 12:30 CET | **premarket** | EU on winter time, US not: server = Brussels + 2 h. A wrong "+1 h" mapping would say 13:30 ny. −25, comm −3, net −28.00 |
| D3 4000301 sell 1.0 | Fri 10-30 22:00 → Mon 11-02 10:30 | Fri 19:00 → Mon 08:30 | Fri 20:00 | outside | held across the US switch; duration **221 400 s** (naive server diff would be 217 800). +200, comm −6, swap −15.40, net **178.60** |
| withdrawal 3000002 (balance −1000) | Sun 11-01 08:30 | **05:30** | 06:30 | – | server hour 08:00–09:00 occurs twice that day; resolved with fold=0 (pre-switch UTC+3) |
| D4 4000401 buy 0.5 | Mon 11-02 10:45 → 11:15 | 08:45 → 09:15 | 09:45 CET | london | both winter: server UTC+2. +50, comm −3, net 47.00; balance at open **49 197.60** |

## Failure fixtures

All share one closed EURUSD trade (account `51234569`, buy 0.10 @1.16000 → 1.16200 by TP,
Tue 2026-10-27 11:00 → 12:00 server = 08:00 → 09:00 UTC, net **19.40**, balance 10 019.40).

| file | scripted failure | expected `Mt5Error.code` |
|---|---|---|
| `fail_login.json` | connect: last_error (−6, "Terminal: Authorization failed") | `login_failed` |
| `fail_terminal_not_found.json` | connect: (−10003, "IPC initialize failed, MetaTrader 5 x64 not found") | `terminal_not_found` |
| `fail_timeout_mid_sync.json` | connect OK, ticks OK, `deals`: (−10005, "IPC timeout") | `timeout` (sync must fail the cycle, keep previous data) |
| `fail_then_recover.json` | step 0 connect: (−10004, "no IPC connection"); step 1: no failure | step 0 `terminal_start_failed`; after `advance()` sync succeeds with the trade above |

Not file-driven: missing `MT5_PASSWORD_<login>` → `password_missing` (pass `password=None`);
connecting to any fixture with another login/server → `login_failed`; ad-hoc failures via
`FixtureMt5Source.fail(method, Mt5Error(...))`.
